I couldn't find any result for the October 13 match that was published on or before October 7. Many pages refused to load (ESPN, Wikipedia, the club site, the SI and Sportsgambler previews), so several facts below come from search summaries and are marked as unverified. I left out everything dated after October 7, including a previewed Liga game at Alavés on October 10.

## 1. Resolution source
- The match is the 2026-27 Champions League league phase, matchday 2: Atlético de Madrid vs Manchester United. It is on Tuesday 2026-10-13 at 21:00 Madrid time, at the Riyadh Air Metropolitano. [atleticodemadrid.com](https://www.atleticodemadrid.com/prepartidos/atletico-de-madrid-manchester-united-13-10-2026-21-00), [La Nación](https://canchallena.lanacion.com.ar/futbol/champions-league-2026-2027/atletico-de-madrid-manchester-united-5g57bivd61ypbsocjxml7egic/)

- A Swedish referee, Glenn Nyberg, has reportedly been appointed (unverified, search summary only).
- Only a win in the 90 minutes plus stoppage time counts as "Yes", so a draw resolves "No".

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-10-07 the match hasn't been played, and nothing settles the question yet.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-20: Atlético beat Real Madrid 2-1 at home in La Liga (ESPN results list, not opened). [Football Web Pages](https://www.footballwebpages.co.uk/spanish-la-liga/20260920)
- 2026-09-16: Atlético reportedly beat Osasuna 4-0 at home. Sources disagree on the date, so this is unverified. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/team/results/_/id/1068/atletico-madrid)
- 2026-09-13: The Real Sociedad away game was reportedly a 3-0 win, but one preview calls it a 1-1 draw. This is unverified. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/team/results/_/id/1068/atletico-madrid)
- 2026-09-10: Manchester United, managed by Michael Carrick, beat newcomers Sabah 4-0 at Old Trafford in their Champions League opener. Shortly before that they drew 2-2 with Everton and had 4 points from 3 Premier League games. [LBC](https://www.lbc.co.uk/news/sport/champions-league-manchester-united-sabah-fk-4-0-win-michael-carrick/)
- 2026-09-09: Liverpool beat Atlético 2-1 at Anfield in matchday 1. Llorente scored in the 17th minute, then Szoboszlai (40th) and Mac Allister (50th) scored for Liverpool. [Football Web Pages](https://www.footballwebpages.co.uk/match/2026-2027/uefa-champions-league/liverpool/atletico-madrid/591968), [Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2628501/liverpool-fight-back-to-beat-atletico-madrid)
- 2026-09-05: Atlético lost 3-0 at Athletic Club. [Football Web Pages](https://www.footballwebpages.co.uk/match/2026-2027/spanish-la-liga/athletic-bilbao/atletico-madrid/589581)
- I couldn't find Atlético's results or team news from late September to early October that were published before the cutoff.

## 4. Base rates
- **Head to head:** In the 2021-22 Round of 16, Atlético drew 1-1 at home with United and won 1-0 at Old Trafford. [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/news/atletico-madrid-vs-manchester-united-odds-how-to-watch-live-stream-march-15-uefa-champions-league-picks)
- **Atlético at home in Europe:** Under Simeone they have been historically strong at home in the Champions League. I didn't find an exact 2024-26 home win rate in this session.
- **Typical outcomes:** For a home favourite against a strong Premier League side, implied home-win chances usually fall around 40-50%. Draws are common, roughly 25%. This is general context, not a sourced figure.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I couldn't find Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold prices, or bookmaker odds, for this match published by 2026-10-07.
- Previews with Opta and bookmaker numbers exist, but they were published after 2026-10-07, so I left them out.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- One La Liga match on the weekend of 10-11 October, the Alavés game mentioned above, could cause rotation or fatigue.
